question: When the binary number $100101110010_2$ is divided by 4, what is the remainder (give your answer in base 10)?
solution:
Every binary place to the left of the last two has value divisible by 4. Thus the remainder depends only on the last two digits, which are 10. Their base-10 value is 1·2 + 0·1 = 2, already less than 4.
Final answer: 2
